findings.description: The key does not set enable_key_rotation = true, so AWS KMS defaults to false and never rotates the backing key material. The audit bucket key will protect all historical and future ciphertext with a single key version indefinitely, maximising the blast radius if that key material is ever compromised.

No key policy is defined, so the key inherits the AWS KMS default policy that grants the account root principal kms:* and delegates all access decisions to IAM. For an audit/logging key there is no resource-based least-privilege statement restricting which principals may use or administer the key, so effective access is limited only by the account's IAM permissions.
